title: The release-size control chart and the WIP limit (contract 1.19.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.19.0. `control` in readiness.json, derived from Control in src/readiness/control.ts; and, under definitions/history, releases.json, the release history `harness readiness --fetch-releases` reads from GitHub once per build of the pages (ReleaseHistory in src/readiness/releases.ts). An XmR (individuals) chart of the monorepo's release sizes in merged PRs: centre = mean, UCL = mean + 2.66 x mean moving range, LCL = max(0, mean - 2.66 x mean moving range); provisional with fewer than 10 releases, when the WIP limit is the centre line instead of the UCL. Advisory: never read by a verdict, the Gate, the score or an exit code. Not stable: it may change in a minor release.

releases.description: Past releases, oldest first, each flagged when it falls outside the limits.

limits.description: Null with fewer than two releases (no moving range).

n.description: Releases the limits were computed from.

centre.description: The mean release size, to two decimals.

provisional.description: Fewer than 10 releases: the limits will move, and the WIP limit is the centre line.

wipLimit.description: The UCL, or the centre line while the limits are provisional; null without limits.

current.description: The batch on main not yet released; null when nothing counts it.

from.description: github: releases.json, read when the pages were built. forecast: the newest kept forecast's changes.json.

tone.description: The colour the page draws; never shown without `label`.

nights.description: The unreleased count night by night (the newest kept forecast of each UTC night), oldest first.

prs.description: PRs since production in the forecast's changes.json (release/* and direct commits left out).

source.description: What was read of the release history, or why it was not. For people: do not parse.

zone.description: below centre: at or below the centre line. release soon: above the centre line, within the WIP limit (a good time to release). release now: over the WIP limit.

special.description: Outside the limits: a special cause.

previous.description: The tag before it: the size counts from here.

prs.description: PRs merged on the first-parent line from `previous` to `tag`, release/* branches and direct commits left out.

releases.description: At most the 30 most recent, oldest first.

errors.description: What GitHub did not answer, or a range too big to count. For people: do not parse.
